_doc: Street View corrections applied by tools/build-map.py on top of OSM. Add entries; no code changes needed.
buildings: keyed by OSM way id ("134101085"), relation id with an r ("r18783929"), or "new:<slug>" for a building OSM lacks.
lv: storeys (height = lv x 3.3 m x SCALE). t: office (glass tower) | block (concrete office/govt) | college | resi | shop | low.
colour: facade tint "#rrggbb". label: parody signage only (AGENTS.md: no real brands). n: name (null removes a bad OSM name).
hs: height source, default "sv" when lv is given; use "guess" if the floors weren't counted. drop: true removes the footprint.
new:<slug> needs a footprint: ll = [[lat, lon], ...] (preferred) or p = [[x, z], ...] in game units.
src: where the numbers came from and how the footprint was matched. Keep it honest about uncertainty.
pois: name -> {ll: [lat, lon]} or {osm: <node id in osm-pois.json / osm-streets.json>}, plus src.
Street View panos and satellite tiles are in research/streetview/img/ (gitignored); survey notes in research/streetview/*.md.

134101262.src: SOUTH.md §1: TIU main block, grey 2-storey podium, white-and-glass tower of 10-12 floors, rounded glass drum on the north end (sv01_tiugate_h288, sv01b_tiugate_fov60_h300). OSM w134101262 (building=college, 66x91 m) is the only footprint on the west side of Street 2 between 22.5756 and 22.5762; it lines up with the white building on sat275_a_tiu_pwc.

new:pwc-more-sw-tower.src: CONFIRM.md §3/§4: this is Ecocentre (Ambuja Neotia, EM-4), one 21-storey slab (B+G+20 per the developer and JLL; the rooftop hotel/sky bar is on floors 19-21), pink-brown spandrels and blue glass, 'ECOCENTRE' on the podium (confirm/g13c_h219) and the hotel name on the crown (confirm/cnt_wipro). The 'new peach tower on the SW corner' in SOUTH.md and the 'brown/pink tower' plus 'AltAir/Capella tower' in NORTH.md are all this one building: the bearing from sv02_st2mid_h288 points at it, not at the corner plot, which is still vacant behind the blue hoarding (matches the satellite). Footprint = the old new:altair + new:capella + new:ecocentre traces merged (2,590 m2; the developer's typical floor is ~2,970 m2). The key name is kept because src/sim/mapdata.test.ts refers to it; a rename is the lead's call.

134101085.label: PWH
134101085.src: SOUTH.md §3: PwC office is a low white building of 2-3 floors with the sign on its parapet, behind a 2 m white wall on the NE corner (sv03_pwcmore_h026, sv03_pwcmore_h116). OSM w134101085 is tagged 'PWC Office' and its south tip is the building nearest the corner.

992001222.src: SOUTH.md §3/§4: 6-8 floor glass office with a telecom mast behind and east of PwC, also seen above the Electronics Complex police gate (sv03_pwcmore_h116, sv101_st13_h027). OSM w992001222 (office=private) is the footprint directly east of PwC; bearings from both panos point at it. Possibly the same tower the survey calls the police station's 7-storey tower.

new:ec-police-station.src: SOUTH.md §4: Electronics Complex Police Station, 40 m east of PwC More on the north side, a white low block inside a compound (sv101_st13_h027). Not in OSM. Footprint traced from the grey-roofed building under the 'ACP Traffic Office / Police Station' pins on sat275_a_tiu_pwc, east of w992001222. Floors not counted (1-2).

new:millennium-city-tower-1.src: SOUTH.md §4 (150-230 m): Millennium City IT Park, the front of two curved glass towers of about 13-14 floors, with the 2-storey podium holding the burger joint on Street 13 (sv104_st13_h027, sv104b_st13_h050). Not in OSM. Footprint fitted inside the OSM service-road loop west of the raised plaza, curved face toward the street, matching the large roof under the 'Netscribes / iMarque' pins on sat275_b_st13west (that tile is only registered to +-3 units here). The podium isn't modelled separately.

193475626.src: SOUTH.md §4: the rear curved glass tower of Millennium City (sv104_st13_h027, sv105_st13_h027). OSM w193475626 'Millenium City IBM DAKSH'; the bearing from the sv105 pano at the main gate points into it.

382403604.src: SOUTH.md §4 (about 110 m): run-down 5-storey peach residential-style block with a blue-glass stair tower by the side road north (sv103_st13_h027). OSM w382403604 is the building nearest the street at that distance on the north side.

986997144.src: SOUTH.md §4 (about 230 m): 5-storey grey office with blue glass bands east of the Millennium City towers (sv104b_st13_h050). Matched by position to OSM w986997144, east of the Millennium City service loop; low confidence.

986997145.src: SOUTH.md §4 (250-300 m): ERTL, a 6-storey white-and-blue-glass block set back behind a red-brown fence (sv106_st13_h027). OSM w986997145 sits under the 'Electronics Regional Test Laboratory' pin on sat275_b_st13west.

986997139.src: SOUTH.md §4 (360-400 m): the dhaba block, 5-storey tan concrete with horizontal sun-shade bands (sv108_st13_h027, sv109_st13_h027). OSM w986997139 is under the dhaba pin on sat275_c_st13east and is the nearest building to the street there.

238287187.src: SOUTH.md §4 (440-470 m), CONFIRM.md §5: grey stone-and-glass tower with the coffee chain at the kerb (sv110_st13_h027, sv111_st13_h027). It is Saltee Tech Park, plot DN-18: the coffee shop's listed address is the ground floor of DN-18 and Google's pin (22.57518, 88.43325) is 10 units from this footprint. Floors corrected from the street estimate of 18-20 to 15 (B+G+14 per JLL and CityInfo; ~650 m2 floor plate, which matches this 556 m2 footprint).

986997138.src: CONFIRM.md §5: Primarc Tower (DN-36), the grey-beige tower with a dark curved glass bay standing behind the white 3-4 storey P.N. Mukherjee building at ~340 m on the north side (confirm/pri_h27). Google's pin (22.57569, 88.43265) lies between this footprint and the dhaba block w986997139; this one is set back from the road, as the tower is. 15 floors per two listings (registered offices up to the 10th floor); roughly consistent with the view (+-2).

238287188.src: SOUTH.md §4/§5: bank building on the NW corner of College More, white, about 8 floors, red portal columns, blue glass band (sv20_collegemore_h027). OSM w238287188 (building=office) is the NW corner footprint.

358887208.src: SOUTH.md §5: Signet Tower (DN-2), about 12 floors, yellow and glass, west side of Street 18 north of College More (sv22_st18north_h290). OSM w358887208 is under the Signet Tower pin on sat275_c_st13east.

new:college-more-ne-tower.src: SOUTH.md §5, CONFIRM.md §5: a tall glass tower of about 20 floors seen NE of College More (sv20_collegemore_h027, confirm/cm_h45). The corner itself is the WBSEDCL Mahishbathan 33/11 kV substation (pale-green 4-storey office with a telecom mast, confirm/cmst18_h120; Google pin 22.57494, 88.43425 at this footprint's west corner), and the tower stands just behind it: a tower crane is still beside it in Jan 2026 and the satellite predates it, so it is newly built. Triangulating confirm/cm_h45 and cmst18_h120 puts it about 12 units north of this footprint, inside the stated +-15 m. Name unknown.

134101300.src: SOUTH.md §5: IEM on the SE corner of College More, glass curtain wall of 6+ floors with a blue band (sv20_collegemore_h117). OSM w134101300 'Institute of Engineering and Management'.

r18783929.src: SOUTH.md §4 (300-430 m south side): Bose Institute unified campus, a big glass building of 8-9 floors with a stepped glass atrium (sv107-sv109_st13_h207). OSM relation r18783929 (multipolygon with a courtyard; geometry in osm-building-relations.json). Its round atrium lines up with sat275_c_st13east.

238287189.src: SOUTH.md §5: Fusion CX glass tower of about 12+ floors on the south side of Street 13 east of College More (sv21_st13east). OSM w238287189 is under the Fusion CX pin on sat275_d_college.

new:pwc-more-se-post.src: SOUTH.md §3, CONFIRM.md §4: small 2-storey building on the SE corner of PwC More, blue-and-white chequered ground floor (police livery) under a blue-and-white glazed upper floor, a Nabadiganta Traffic Guard bus board and Bidhannagar traffic barricades beside it (confirm/pw_h150, confirm/pw_h160_zoom2). No name board is readable; most likely the police post that OSM tags as 'Sector - V Police Station' about 60 m east. Not in OSM; placed on the corner behind the footpath.

193478726.src: CONFIRM.md §3: the 4-star business hotel at ~205 m on the NE side (name and 'Luxury Business Hotel' on the forecourt wall, confirm/g13c_h39; Google's pin for it, 22.57802, 88.42767, falls inside this footprint). Sandstone-clad tower with one vertical glass strip and a dark granite portal, about 10 floors (confirm/cnt_monotel, cnt_monotel2; +-1). NORTH.md had this footprint as IIHM: IIHM is the white block 25 m further SE (new:iihm). Name left off (real brand).

new:iihm.src: CONFIRM.md §3: IIHM Global Campus at ~140-160 m on the NE side of Street 13: white 4-storey block (ground + 3 and a rooftop structure) with a glazed entrance, flags and the campus name on a low wall (confirm/g13a_h39, cnt_iihm, g13b_h39). Not in OSM. 40x25 m rectangle parallel to the road, centred on the building seen straight ahead from the g13a pano and 7 m from Google's pin (22.57757, 88.42811); the roof on confirm/q_s13_sat19 agrees to +-8 m. NORTH.md's '6-8 floors' came from a 2022 courtyard photosphere; from the road it is 4.

193478723.src: CONFIRM.md §3: white 4-storey block at ~230 m on the NE side with a paan/snack stall against its wall (confirm/g13d_h39, right half; bearing from the g13d pano ~56 deg). OSM's 'Hotel Monotel' node sits in this footprint, but the hotel itself is w193478726 next door.

158642186.src: NORTH.md §1, CONFIRM.md §3 (~300-320 m, NE side): cream tower with red spandrel bands and a rounded glass drum at its NW end (confirm/drum_h60 from the NW, col_h39 and cnt_drum from the SE: both bearings land in this crescent-shaped OSM footprint). About 12 floors over a 1-2 storey base (+-1), not 14+. It is NOT the hotel NORTH.md guessed (that is w193478726). Wipro Kolkata Gate 4 is at its SE corner (gate pillar marked '4' in confirm/col_h80), so it is probably part of the Wipro campus; no name sign seen.

158019906.src: NORTH.md §2, CONFIRM.md §3: SE corner of Wipro More, a tower with a rounded blue-glass corner, red-framed balcony bays and the Wipro logo on its crown (confirm/wmse_h100, cnt_wipro; also seen from 3rd Ave in confirm/wa1_h90). About 10 floors (8 balcony levels over a 2-storey base), not 12+. OSM w158019906 at bearing ~100 deg from the s13_08 pano. Red tint for the balcony section; the blue glass corner isn't modelled.

362948042.src: NORTH.md §1/§2, CONFIRM.md §3: red-brick-and-cream block with a crowned parapet in a walled compound with big trees on the SW side near Wipro More (s13_07_h219, confirm/rtc_h219 right edge at bearing ~257 deg). Confirmed as the Regional Training Centre, Ministry of Defence: Google's place (22.57799, 88.42714) is in the same compound and its gate photo shows a 'Govt of India, Ministry of Defence' pillar with this red-and-cream building behind. Floors still partly hidden by trees (5-6).

193479375.src: CONFIRM.md §3: NORTH.md's 'pinkish-beige slab towers of 14-16 floors' were Ecocentre (new:pwc-more-sw-tower) seen from 280 m. Nothing tall stands on this footprint: from the g13d pano (49 units away) a 15-storey tower would rise 36 deg above the horizon at bearing ~198 deg, and confirm/cnt_eco shows only trees and sky there. Google labels this site as an IT company's office; floors not counted, 4 is a placeholder for a low block.

362948053.src: CONFIRM.md §3: not a 14-floor slab (see 193479375). The footprint at bearing ~237 deg from the g13d pano holds a tan 3-4 storey block with balconies behind the compound wall (confirm/g13d_h219, right edge), inside or beside the Ministry of Defence training-centre compound.

535333500.src: OSM w535333500 'IT Centre (Sector V)' (building=construction, construction:railway=station) is the Orange Line station box. It is drawn with the viaducts by src/render/world/stations.ts (NORTH.md §4), so the footprint must not also become a building.

237896675.src: The OSM name on this house is crude vandalism; don't ship it. Levels stay from OSM.

tiu.src: OSM amenity=university node for Techno India University (unchanged).

pwc.src: SOUTH.md §3: the PwC sign and white wall are right on the NE corner of PwC More; this is the street-facing south tip of w134101085 (moved about 30 m SW from the old point 22.57753, 88.42967).

burger.src: OSM fast_food node in the Millennium City podium (was hand-typed on the road centre line).
